Omg this is so amazing!!! Everybody needs to try this product

This is the only cleanser that works at calming my acne breakouts! You'll see results overnight!
This cleanser is a game changer. You don't need much to get rid of all the impurities!

I recently added the Blume cleanser to my skincare routine and have been really enjoying it. It leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and soft without drying it out. I love how gentle it feels, and I actually look forward to using it every day. So far, it has been a great addition to my routine, and I'm excited to keep using it.
Love this product! After using it consistently for a few months my acne is soooooo much better and my skin feels so good. Nothing else has worked like this line has!
This cleanser has become a staple in my routine, and has reduced the appearance of redness on my face, and never dries out my skin. I will definitely repurchase!
I love how gentle this cleanser was on my skin and I think it smells great. After using this cleanser for more than 6 weeks now it has helped reduce my acne.

avis.titre: Reduced breakouts, non-drying, and gentle on eczema-prone sk
avis.texte: I noticed that after using this cleanser consistently for a few weeks, my breakouts became much less frequent. It cleansed my skin well without leaving it feeling tight or dry after washing, which I really appreciated. Even with regular use, it was gentle enough that it didn't irritate or worsen the eczema on my cheeks.

The texture is a gel that foams really nicely. The scent is fresh and subtle(slightly citrus) and leaves the skin feeling hydrated, not tight. I found this was very gentle for my sensitive, red skin. It visibly reduced redness and inflammation after use. After 6 weeks of use I still have a decent amount of product left- good value. Where this falls short is removing waterproof mascara or eyeliner. I definitely recommend this for acne prone and sensitive skin!

This cleanser does a great job of cleansing my skin as well as removing makeup. I like that it is non-drying and still leaves my skin feeling clean. I wish it had a pump packaging though as I prefer that for a cleanser.

I love this cleanser!!! I have really sensitive skin that can be quite dry and lots of cleansers can feel really stripping on my skin. This one makes my skin feel so clean without feeling like all the moisture has been stripped from my skin!

avis.titre: Been using for months and months and I'm loving it!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for months and months now, and I have repurchased it a handful of times. It's gentle yet effective. I have very sensitive and acne prone skin and this has not irritated it once. A little goes a long way and I found that it lasted me for so long! The ingredients are safe for me to use as well on my acne prone skin. Would recommend if you're looking for a new everyday cleanser!
I like the texture of the cleanser and how it foams, but it's not too drying
This is an INCREDIBLE cleaner! You truly only need a dime size and it goes a long way. It's awesome because the cleaner is really bubbly which makes for a great cleanser. Leaves my skin soooo fresh !

avis.titre: A must-have for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I am so happy I found this product. It completely changed my skin texture and I have found my skin is less red, I have less breakouts and my skin isn't as oily.

avis.titre: Great gentle cleanser for acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Blume Meltdown Gel Cleanser for a few weeks now, and it's become a staple in my routine. The texture is a lightweight gel that lathers just enough to feel like it's properly cleansing without stripping my skin. What I love most is how balanced it is. It helps keep my breakouts under control (likely from the salicylic acid), but at the same time, my skin never feels tight or dry after using it. My skin actually feels soft, calm, and hydrated, which is rare for an acne-focused cleanser. It works well for removing everyday dirt and oil, but if you wear heavier makeup, I would recommend double cleansing. The only thing to note is that it does contain some fragrant/essential oil ingredients, so if you're very sensitive, that's something to keep in mind. Personally, I didn't experience any irritation. Overall, I'd definitely recommend this if you're looking for a gentle but effective cleanser for acne-prone or combination skin.

avis.titre: This cleanser has been great for my acne prone skin
avis.texte: This cleanser left my skin feeling a lot cleaner and healthier. After using it for a couple of weeks I have experienced a lot less breakouts and I believe it has significantly cleared my skin of acne.
Obsessed with this product. It only takes one single cleanse to get my tubing mascara off, and my skin feels hydrated and clean after.

avis.titre: A game changer for adult acne
avis.texte: My favourite cleanser I have ever used. It made my skin feel so clean without stripping my skin barrier. The ultimate act of self care was trying blumes products. It has been an absolute game changer for my adult acne - for the first time I have found a natural, consistent and helpful product that makes me feel so much more confident and helps calm and heal my acne and skin barrier.

avis.titre: One Wash Was All It Took!
avis.texte: I was honestly blown away by how well this cleanser performed. It got my face completely clean in just one wash — and that's saying a lot because I'm usually a double-cleanser by habit. It's thorough without being harsh, and my skin felt fresh and balanced right after. No tightness, no dryness. Just clean, happy skin. Will definitely be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Reduced redness and severity of acne
avis.texte: My 13 year old daughter uses this daily and it is one of the few products that has actually helped her acne! I will be honest in saying that she isn't 100% acne free by any means, but after using this product for 9+ months, the redness is reduced and severity of her acne. I feel good about providing her with a safe and more natural product and would recommend giving this product a try!

I am OBSESSED with this cleanser. A little goes a long way so the actual bottle lasts forever. This is one of the only cleansers that doesn't make me feel dry or cause break outs, I literally can't get enough of it

Blume has done wonders for my 16 year old daughter's skin! Cleared up all those tiny bumps on her forehead and she now has less breakouts! She loves Blume products and has told all her friends about it!

avis.titre: Finally! An acne cleanser that doesn't sting my sensitive sk
avis.texte: I received the Meltdown Daily Balancing Gel Cleanser for testing in exchange for my honest review, and after two weeks of daily use, my skin has never felt more balanced. Finding a cleanser for sensitive, acne-prone skin is usually a nightmare—most products for breakouts are way too harsh and leave my face red and stinging. This gel cleanser is the complete opposite! My skin feels much calmer, deeply hydrated, and noticeably less irritated. I've seen a huge reduction in the redness I usually get with hormonal breakouts. The consistency is absolutely perfect—it's not too runny or thick—and the scent is incredibly pleasant and soothing.

avis.titre: love this cleanser for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: this cleanser is so gentle yet effective without causing my face to feel dry. I love it.
I added this face wash to my routine a few months ago and wow it is wonderful! You don't need much per use so it does last a long time and has helped me feel more confident1
It leaves my skin feeling very clean but not dry and it smells amazing
This cleanser is so nice and creamy. I have sensitive skin and this does have a scent but I love it and it doesn't bother me.

This cleanser hasn't done anything for my acne. It's not a great product if your acne is severe. I believe it may be fine for the most basic skin type that occasionally gets pimples. But for an adult with actual acne, it's done nothing. Their oil and face cream are incredibly soft and keep my skin from drying out. I love those products for that reason. But none of it has help clear up my breakouts.

I adore this face wash! It never strips or dries my skin, helps clear breakouts, and melts away makeup like a dream. Definitely not just for teens/20 somethings, it's gentle and amazing on this late 30's babe.

This is the cleanser of my dreams! I love how it feels going on, and it leaves my skin totally clean of dirt and makeup but not dried out. This + meltdown oil + meltdown cream is my holy grail routine < 3

I love Blume for their clean and effective ingredients, and this set has all my favorites. The Meltdown Gel is my go-to daily moisturizer, while the Milky Fade Serum works wonders on acne scars and redness. Before bed, I love using the Meltdown Oil for an extra boost of hydration. Perfect for keeping my skin happy on the go!
